setup.description: Install and verify uv, optionally configure a Python version and isolated tools, and publish their environment.

version.description: Tool release or supported channel to install; omitted values use the documented default.

installDir.description: Absolute per-user installation prefix; omit for native package installations.

packageName.description: Native package or port selector overriding the default repository package name.

sudo.description: Use noninteractive sudo for native package or system installation; defaults to false.

pythonVersion.description: Optional Python release or interpreter selector such as 3.13 or cpython-3.13.1; omit to retain uv-only setup. BSD selects an existing matching interpreter without downloads.

tools.description: Comma-separated Python CLI packages with optional single native version constraints, such as ruff==0.12.0,httpie. Blank or omitted values install no tools.
